channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: NATO jet downs drone in Romania near Ukraine border
item.description: This is the latest in a series of incidents involving drone incursions into NATO airspace from Ukraine.

item.title: Anne Hathaway and Bob Iger to receive 2026 Disney Legends Awards
item.description: Disney's top honor recognizes stars, storytellers, and leaders across the company.

item.title: Hurricane Lala, a Category 1 storm, brings heavy rain, wind, flooding to Hawaii
item.description: Lala intensified into a Category 1 hurricane as it moved through the central Pacific Ocean, nearing the Big Island of Hawaii on Saturday.

item.title: Va. State shooting: Suspect arrested, found hiding in dorm closet, police say
item.description: A suspect in the shooting at Virginia State University early Saturday that wounded five people, one critically, has been arrested, according to police.
